Introduction.Purpose: DineOut is an android application that aims to digitalize the process of various restaurant management operations including ordering and inventory management and POS. This document aims to capture the system requirements and features particularly related to ordering and inventory management to be implemented in DineOut version 1.0.

DocumentConventions.PriorityConventions: Priorities are mentioned as "low" or "high" throughout the document.
DocumentConventions.FontsConventions: User entities are capitalized. Significant terms in the glossary are bold and italic.

Introduction.IntendedAudience: Customers for approval and further processing. Development team and testers for reference.
Introduction.ProductScope: A restaurant management system developed to automate day-to-day tasks like order and inventory management, bill generation, and feedback, eradicating daily paperwork and improving performance.

References.Reference: IEEE Std 830-1998 Recommended Practice for Software Requirements Specifications

OverallDescription.ProductPerspective: DineOut app replaces manual ordering. It consists of a mobile application (with interfaces for Customer, Manager, Head Chef, Admin, and Chef) and a Firebase database.

ProductFunctions.Function: Allow Customers to scroll menu, select dishes, cancel/edit order, provide feedback, request bill, and ask for help.
Assign Head Chef to distribute dishes to chefs.
Allow admin CRUD operations on Staff, Menu, and Inventory.
Allow Head Chef to mark orders complete and approve cancellations.
Allow Hall Manager to mark bills paid, view table status, and receive notifications.

UserClasses.UserClass: Interacts directly to place/modify orders, get bills, and give feedback.
Marks dishes prepared, approves cancellations, and assigns dishes to chefs.
Marks bills as paid, views table status, and receives help/order notifications.

OverallDescription.OperatingEnvironment: Android application running on tablets in a restaurant environment.

DesignAndImplementationConstraints.Constraint: Compatible with tablets, not necessary for small mobile devices.

UserInterfaces.Interface: Includes Place Order, Timer/Edit/Cancel, and Feedback screens.
Shows current orders and allows marking dishes as cooked or approving removal.
Receives notifications, shows order list for billing, and table status.
Screens for CRUD operations on Staff, Menu, and Inventory.

ExternalInterfaceRequirements.HardwareInterfaces: Bill printer, optional credit card reader, central kitchen screen.
ExternalInterfaceRequirements.SoftwareInterfaces: Firebase database, Android 6.0+, v4 support library Print Helper.
ExternalInterfaceRequirements.CommunicationsInterfaces: HTTP protocol to connect to Firebase.

Feature.name: Place Order
Feature.Description: System displays available dishes. Customers can select dishes and quantities.

Feature.name: Customer Help
Feature.Description: Customers can ask for help from the Hall Manager via a help button.

Feature.name: Chef Order Queue
Feature.Description: Dishes are classified and assigned to specific chefs' queues based on specialties.

Feature.name: Edit Order
Feature.Description: Customers can change quantity, add, or remove dishes before serving (removal needs Head Chef approval).

Feature.name: Cancel Order
Feature.Description: Customers can cancel the order before serving (needs Head Chef approval).

Feature.name: Mark Dish as Cooked
Feature.Description: Head Chef marks dishes as cooked, triggering a notification to the Hall Manager when the full order is done.

Feature.name: Request Bill
Feature.Description: Customers ask for the receipt, prompting the Hall Manager to print and mark it paid.

Feature.name: Customer Feedback
Feature.Description: Customers provide feedback via multiple-choice questions.

Feature.name: Add/Edit/Delete Menu Items
Feature.Description: Admin can manage the restaurant's menu.

NonFunctionalRequirements.Performance: Interactive with minimal delays (less than 2s for menu scrolling, less than 1s for order visibility).
NonFunctionalRequirements.Safety: Environmentally friendly, flexible font for visibility.
NonFunctionalRequirements.Security: Encrypted login for admin/head chef, secure transmission to Firebase.

SoftwareQualityAttributes.Attribute: Menu and employee/inventory database can be changed.
Input validation for menu items, emails, and phone numbers.

BusinessRules.Rule: Managers can view table status but not modify.
Only admins can perform CRUD on DB.
Only Head Chef can manage queues.

Glossary.Term: Android library to connect to remote printers.
